name: National Archeological Park of Tierradentro
description: In the mountains of Cauca, southwest Colombia, about 100 km from Popayán, Tierradentro hides underground tombs carved between the 6th and 10th centuries. You descend spiral stairways into chambers up to 12 m wide, their walls and ceilings painted in red, black and white to echo the interiors of ancient homes. Stone statues of human figures stand nearby.
